test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

I said to Anita, “I enjoyed my trip to Shivpuri.”

options.text: I told Anita that I had enjoyed my trip to Shivpuri.
I am told Anita that I had enjoyed my trip to Shivpuri.
I told Anita that I had been enjoying my trip to Shivpuri.
I said Anita that I had enjoyed my trip to Shivpuri.

solution:
The correct answer is "**I told Anita that I had enjoyed my trip to Shivpuri.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few rules to keep in mind when converting a direct speech to an indirect speech.
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb "**said to**"(direct speech) changes to **"told" **in indirect speech.
 
• In case the reporting verb is in the present tense or future tense, we should not change the verbs in the indirect speech.
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb is in the **past tense**.
 
• So, the verb in the simple past tense "**I enjoyed**" changes to past perfect tense "**I had enjoyed**".

Hence, the correct sentence is **option 1**.
